Problem Statement:
Use `flox` for median-aggregation in groupbys

### Is your feature request related to a problem?

If I'm not mistaken, [flox does support median/nanmedian aggregation](https://flox.readthedocs.io/en/latest/generated/flox.xarray.xarray_reduce.html) for groupby reduce operations. But currently, while [Xarray's docs](https://docs.xarray.dev/en/stable/generated/xarray.core.groupby.DataArrayGroupBy.median.html#xarray.core.groupby.DataArrayGroupBy.median) indicates that median reduction on groupbys should use flox when available, I'm not sure this is actually implemented:

https://github.com/pydata/xarray/blob/885e8d111996e4164bac2a3179ff9f4361d58c7b/xarray/core/_aggregations.py#L7807-L7813

I'm happy to open a PR if median-reductions should indeed use flox when available!

### Describe the solution you'd like

Median-reduction on groupbys should use flox when available.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### Additional context

Currently, I resort to using flox's `xarray_reduce` function directly, which dramatically speeds up median-reduction.

        for method in self.methods:
            yield self.generate_method(method)

            clarification=method.clarification,

                if self.has_keep_attrs
